audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 4/10 and 'Favoured matchup' contradict a 36.67% win rate over 30 games and the page's own 'HARD' diff tag.
audit.why: Karma is a 950-range enchanter with no dash; Mordekaiser's Death's Grasp (E, 700 range, 16/14/12/10/8s) pulls her into Obliterate range and Realm of Death (140/120/100s) removes every ally from the fight. The lane is hard, not favoured.
audit.corrected: diffRating 7/10, carryRating 8/10, matching the HARD tag and the 36.67% figure.
sources: kits: Death's Grasp, Realm of Death

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart showed Karma winning all seven stages while the whys text says Mordekaiser owns Level 2 and Level 6 and calls Levels 1, 4-5 and first item even.
audit.why: Mantra is online at level 1 so Karma's poke is real, but Indestructible refunds chip and Realm of Death is the flip at 6. Packet levelChart agrees: Skill / Mordekaiser / Karma / Skill / Mordekaiser / Skill / Karma.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill, Mordekaiser, Karma, Skill, Mordekaiser, Skill, Karma with ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two entries duplicated the trade text instead of stating the interaction, and Death's Grasp was never named.
audit.why: The decisive mechanic is Death's Grasp (E) pulling Karma inside Obliterate's single-target bonus damage at 675-700 range, and Realm of Death removing outside help. Karma's W tether reveals and roots but cannot break the realm; her E shield only delays it.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now states the 140/120/100s R cooldown and the pre-shield timing; dontsFull[2].d now states the freeze/pull interaction.

audit.why: Missing-interaction rule flags Indestructible sustain needing Grievous Wounds; report[8] already says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain.'
